title: AmEx Qantas Ultimate: Bonus 50,000 Qantas Points with $5,000 Spend in Months 13-15 of Membership, $450 Per Year Fee
body:
Deal: AmEx Qantas Ultimate: Bonus 50,000 Qantas Points with $5,000 Spend in Months 13-15 of Membership, $450 Per Year Fee

[A female dog] Churning is dying.
Previously had this card and it was very good at the time.
Wondering if this is one of those cards I should just consider keeping, now that churning is no longer attractive (or not at least as attractive as before).
[nategasm] This card was always one of the better ones to keep. I've been keeping this card while churning other cards with no issue.
Hard to get (anti-churner), low credit limit, decent earn rate, annual fee offset by Qantas credit hack, statement credit offers, referral bonuses etc.
[aparasher] Yes. Points earnings are being slashed by all other banks with new changes coming. Lets hope this card's points remain unchanged.
[worthy1] Yeh i have kept mine. Had this and NAB but cancelled the NAB before the next yearly fee. I believe the amex had the better $ per point return so i kept it. The only issue is i still run into places that dont take AMEX, that will be a pain if i am still needing to put it on credit so i am on the hunt for another credit card with a point bonus as a backup in case.
[Yobi] Do you mind sharing the Qantas credit hack?
[v8o] Book flight ticket on a refundable fare using your $450 credit, wait for credit to be credited, refund flight ticket.
[EBC] @v8o: When I did it you don't even have to wait. I booked economy Sydney to Adelaide and cancelled within 24 hours (I think a couple hours after booking) and was still credited.
[nategasm] Book a Qantas Flight from the Amex travel portal then cancel it same day for full refund + keep the credits. Full instructions in other deal
[cski] i had to cancel mine because i could no longer gift lounge passes to my wife and mother
you must travel with them which sucks cause work does my flight and they always took a different one to meet there
[CptnObvious] Does this mean QF points will be worth more if sold on marketplace?
[whoistheg] You almost better buying 2 sets of $420 wine from Qantas wine with 25,000 bonus points than this..
edit:
Ahh miss read this— so if you stay the distance and keep pumping a heap of $ in the card you could possible get 120,000
[solidfruit] Curious what people actually do to keep track of sign up offers, the webpages/promotion info come and go long before the period is up, and you don't get tracker in account/app, it's like dealing with pop up street stalls.
[BestTechAdvisor] I'll probably get negged for recommending AI, but you could easily use Claude to track sign-up offers.
[luckylittle] I don't see how - unless you give it access to your calendar and let it put the events in there?
[BestTechAdvisor] You could connect your calendar or similar, or you could just store the information in .MD files and schedule weekly or monthly reports. I do both for a variety of stuff.
